item.myfirstmod.ascended_nullblade.toolt: Empowered Soul Rend, longer Riftstep, faster recovery.
item.myfirstmod.null_relic.tooltip: Use: regeneration, absorption, slow falling. 45-second cooldown.
item.myfirstmod.resonant_shard.tooltip: Eight shards surround amethyst to form a Resonance Matrix.
item.myfirstmod.resonance_matrix.tooltip: Smith with Nullblade and an echo shard to awaken the blade.
message.myfirstmod.welcome: THE NULL REALM // The Hushed Threshold
message.myfirstmod.expedition_hint: Rest at the sanctuary waystone. Explore for cathedral embers, ore, and relics before challenging the Warden. Your journal explains the journey; the return gate remains open.
message.myfirstmod.trial_peaceful: The court is silent in Peaceful difficulty.
message.myfirstmod.trial_survival: Enter Survival or Adventure mode to begin this trial.
message.myfirstmod.trial_cooldown: The core is recovering. Ready in %s seconds.
message.myfirstmod.trial_begin: RESONANCE TRIAL // Defeat three waves. Stay near the court; allies nearby are enrolled.
message.myfirstmod.trial_ascended: ASCENDED TRIAL // The Warden has fallen. Stronger guardians now defend richer rewards.
message.myfirstmod.trial_complete: COURT RESTORED // Resonant shards and experience claimed. This court reawakens in five minutes.
message.myfirstmod.trial_blocked: The court is obstructed. Clear space around the core and return after it recovers.
message.myfirstmod.victory_rewards: Claimed: Nullblade, Heart of the Null, four Resonant Shards, and 500 experience.
message.myfirstmod.after_victory: The Echo Altar is awake. Explore sunken archive vaults, push court tiers, then offer an Echo Sigil at (8, 81, 30). Your journal records the path forward.
cinematic.myfirstmod.awakening.subtitle: The city was a lock. You were the key.
cinematic.myfirstmod.transition.subtitle: Sneak near the glowing pylons to drain their power.
cinematic.myfirstmod.victory.subtitle: Beyond the fallen guardian, the courts awaken.

item.myfirstmod.rift_aegis.tooltip: Use: reflect hostile projectiles ahead and gain resistance II for 3s. Cooldown: 12s.
message.myfirstmod.no_courts: No discovered court is ready. Routing to the arena.

message.myfirstmod.altar_sigil: Hold an Echo Sigil and use this altar to begin a rematch.
message.myfirstmod.rematch_begin: ECHO RITUAL // Challenge level %s. Pylon pairs will reactivate between phases. Enter the arena!
message.myfirstmod.rematch_rewards: ECHO DEFEATED // Claimed a Warden Crest, eight shards, and 350 XP. First-time victors also receive the blade and heart.
journal.myfirstmod.progress:
NULL EXPEDITION

Biomes: %s / 4
Known courts: %s
Trials cleared: %s
Best tier: %s / 5
Warden victories: %s

Reopen this journal to update your record.
journal.myfirstmod.exploration:
THE THRESHOLD

The lit causeway leads to the arena. The gate behind you leads home.

Sneak-use your compass to select arena, sanctuary, or a known ready court.
journal.myfirstmod.trials:
RESONANCE COURTS

Use a core to enroll nearby allies. Late arrivals get no rewards.

After the boss, sneak-use a core to attempt your next tier. Five tiers await. Leaving for 30s ends a trial.
journal.myfirstmod.oaths:
COURT OATHS

Fracture: dodge fixed fire circles.

Siphon: sneak at both ward circles to stop enemy healing.

Pursuit: hunters move faster. Final waves have a captain.
journal.myfirstmod.warden:
THE NULL WARDEN

Attacks commit to marked locations. Dodge the marks, then strike in recovery.

Sneak near a glowing pylon to cleanse it. Its inner pocket grounds pylon pulses, NOT boss attacks.
journal.myfirstmod.equipment:
RELICS

Hold then release the Nullblade to rend. Sneak-use to step safely forward.

Use the Heart for healing and slow falling.

Smith your blade with a Matrix and echo shard to awaken it.
journal.myfirstmod.endgame:
THE ECHO RITUAL

Offer an Echo Sigil at 8, 81, 30 after victory. Tier 2+ courts and vaults grant sigils.

Rematches award crests. Craft a crest, shield, and Matrix into the projectile-deflecting Rift Aegis.
message.myfirstmod.reward_mail: EXPEDITION REWARDS // %s victories claimed: %s shards, %s Warden Crests, and experience.
message.myfirstmod.first_relics: First victory: the Nullblade and Heart of the Null are yours.
item.myfirstmod.raw_resonite.tooltip: Smelt into Resonite Ingots. Found below Y=65 in the Null Realm.
item.myfirstmod.resonite_ingot.tooltip: Forge diamond-tier expedition tools. Also repairs Resonite equipment.
item.myfirstmod.prism_dust.tooltip: Prism Staff ammunition and luminous crafting material.
item.myfirstmod.cinder_pearl.tooltip: An ember-rich mineral used in mauls and fire-resistance tonics.
item.myfirstmod.dusk_fiber.tooltip: Harvest Hush Leaves for bindings, charms, and repair supplies.
item.myfirstmod.hushberry.tooltip: A nourishing fruit found among Hush Leaves.
item.myfirstmod.expedition_stew.tooltip: Restores 10 hunger. Returns its bowl after eating.
item.myfirstmod.ember_tonic.tooltip: Drink for 60 seconds of fire resistance. Returns a glass bottle.
item.myfirstmod.resonite_pickaxe.tooltip: Diamond-tier mining. 1,800 durability. Repair with Resonite Ingots.
item.myfirstmod.resonite_axe.tooltip: An expedition axe forged from Resonite. 1,800 durability.
item.myfirstmod.resonite_shovel.tooltip: A durable digging tool. Repair with Resonite Ingots.
item.myfirstmod.prism_staff.tooltip: Use: 24-block precision beam, 8 damage. Consumes one Prism Dust. 1.5s cooldown.
item.myfirstmod.cinder_maul.tooltip: Use while grounded: a 4-block hostile-only slam. 6s cooldown.
item.myfirstmod.survey_lens.tooltip: Use: locate up to three ores in a 6-block cube radius. Does not load chunks.
item.myfirstmod.veil_charm.tooltip: Use: invisibility and speed for 8s. 45s cooldown; armor remains visible.
item.myfirstmod.repair_kit.tooltip: Use to restore 400 durability to a mod item held in your other hand.
item.myfirstmod.wayfarer_thread.tooltip: Channel 3s to recall to your waystone. Sneak for sanctuary. Damage interrupts; 60s cooldown.
message.myfirstmod.staff_fuel: The Prism Staff needs Prism Dust in your inventory.
message.myfirstmod.repair_hint: Hold a damaged Null Realm item in your other hand to repair it.
message.myfirstmod.survey_empty: The lens finds no realm ores within six blocks.
message.myfirstmod.waystone_bound: WAYSTONE ATTUNED // %s, %s, %s. Channel a Wayfarer Thread to return here.
message.myfirstmod.recall_locked: Recall is blocked during nearby boss encounters, enrolled trials, or recent damage.
message.myfirstmod.recall_blocked: Recall failed: no safe landing, missing waystone, or active combat.
journal.myfirstmod.resources:
THE LIVING REALM

Mine Nullstone below Y=65 for Resonite, Prism Dust, and Cinder Pearls. Iron-tier tools or better are needed.

Smelt Resonite. Harvest Hush Leaves for fiber and food.
journal.myfirstmod.wilds_gear:
EXPEDITION GEAR

The Prism Staff spends dust for precise ranged attacks.

Grounded maul slams push enemies away.

Hold damaged mod gear in your other hand to use a Repair Kit.
journal.myfirstmod.waystones:
WAYSTONES

Bind at a shrine. Channel a Wayfarer Thread for 3s to recall; sneak for sanctuary. Damage interrupts.

No recall from boss fights or enrolled trials. Cooldown: 60s.
journal.myfirstmod.bound_stone:
BOUND WAYSTONE

%s

If its landing is blocked, recall fails without spending the cooldown.
journal.myfirstmod.no_stone: No shrine bound. Your thread returns to the sanctuary.
item.myfirstmod.resonite_helmet.tooltip: Full Resonite set in the Null Realm: night vision and haste I. Repair with ingots.
item.myfirstmod.resonite_chestplate.tool: Full Resonite set in the Null Realm: night vision and haste I. Repair with ingots.
item.myfirstmod.resonite_leggings.toolti: Full Resonite set in the Null Realm: night vision and haste I. Repair with ingots.
item.myfirstmod.resonite_boots.tooltip: Full Resonite set in the Null Realm: night vision and haste I. Repair with ingots.
attunement.myfirstmod.vigor: Vigor: ability hits restore 1 heart (10s cooldown)
attunement.myfirstmod.gale: Gale: ability casts grant Speed I for 4s (10s cooldown)
message.myfirstmod.forge_hint: Hold a relic in your main hand and a rune in your offhand to attune it.
message.myfirstmod.forge_replace: Sneak while using the forge to replace this attunement. The old rune is lost.
message.myfirstmod.forge_same: This relic already has that attunement.
message.myfirstmod.rift_begin: Convergence begun! Sneak on the three glowing seals to ground them. Defend against the sentinels!
message.myfirstmod.herald_emerging: The seals break. The Rift Herald emerges!
message.myfirstmod.rift_closed: Rift closed! Your expedition rewards are ready to claim.
journal.myfirstmod.convergence:
CONVERGENCE
Rifts closed: %s
Find ruined observatories in new realm chunks. Use the central anchor in Survival. Nearby allies join. Sneak on each glowing seal for 3s, then defeat the Herald. Dodge marked bursts; its ring is safe inside 3 blocks or beyond 6.
journal.myfirstmod.attunement:
ATTUNEMENT
Rifts award Astral Cores. Craft a rune with a core, shard, and golden apple (Vigor), feather (Gale), or prism dust (Focus). At a forge, hold your relic main-hand and rune offhand. Sneak to replace. One rune per relic; shared effect cooldowns.
journal.myfirstmod.cultivation:
CULTIVATION
Craft two Hush Nurseries with two hushberries, dusk fiber, and lumen moss. Plant on dirt, moss, grass, or farmland. They grow in realm darkness; elsewhere provide light. Bonemeal speeds growth. Use mature plants for berries and fiber without uprooting.
item.myfirstmod.astral_core.tooltip: Close Convergence rifts to earn cores. Craft with a shard and an attunement ingredient.
item.myfirstmod.vigor_rune.tooltip: Forge into a relic: successful abilities heal one heart. Shared 10s cooldown.
item.myfirstmod.gale_rune.tooltip: Forge into a relic: casts grant Speed I for 4s. Shared 10s cooldown.
item.myfirstmod.focus_rune.tooltip: Forge into a relic: 20% shorter ability cooldowns.
message.myfirstmod.rift_mail: CONVERGENCE // Claimed %s Astral Cores, shards, and experience.
herald.myfirstmod.attack.1: ASTRAL BURST // Leave the marked circle!
herald.myfirstmod.attack.2: STAR RING // Move inside 3 blocks or beyond 6!
item.myfirstmod.ashen_flask.tooltip: Realm only. Hold use: heal 4 hearts (1.6s). Sneak-use near a safe waystone: rest for 5s. Charges are shared across flasks. Damage interrupts.
item.myfirstmod.pilgrim_step.tooltip: Use: grounded 3-block forward evasion. Sneak-use: backstep. 2.5s cooldown. Stops at walls and ledges; no invulnerability.
item.myfirstmod.mourning_ember.tooltip: Hold offhand while resting with an Ashen Flask to permanently gain one charge. Maximum five. Recovered from cathedral reliquaries.
message.myfirstmod.pilgrim_kit: ASHEN PILGRIMAGE // Your flask and Pilgrim’s Step are ready. Rest near waystones; seek cathedral embers to strengthen the flask. Read your journal before venturing out.
message.myfirstmod.rest_unsafe: Rest requires a nearby waystone, solid footing, no enrolled encounter, and no hostiles within 12 blocks.
message.myfirstmod.flask_empty: The flask is empty, or you are already at full health. Refill by resting at a safe waystone.
message.myfirstmod.flask_upgraded: An ember joins the flame. Flask capacity: %s.
message.myfirstmod.rested: RESTORED // Health and flask charges replenished.
message.myfirstmod.cathedral_riddle: THE FUNERARY RITE // Remember first the drowned beneath the nave, then the crowned beneath the vault, and last the nameless beside the resting heart.
message.myfirstmod.cathedral_reward: A LIGHT FOR THE NAMELESS // Mourning Ember, six shards, Echo Sigil, and experience recovered. Rest with the ember in your offhand to strengthen your flask.
message.myfirstmod.cathedral_open: The final bell falls silent. The lowest reliquary is unsealed.
message.myfirstmod.cathedral_wrong: The rite is broken. All seals fall dark. Remember: drowned, crowned, nameless.
message.myfirstmod.cathedral_spent: The resting heart is gone. This seal has no answer.
region.myfirstmod.luminous_fen: A light beneath the mourning water
region.myfirstmod.prism_wastes: The shattered crown of a silent kingdom
region.myfirstmod.cinder_steps: Only the ashes kept their names
journal.myfirstmod.pilgrimage:
ASHEN PILGRIMAGE

The kingdom buried its names beneath its churches. Seek their embers, rest at waystones, and return stronger.

New cathedrals rise beyond explored lands. Your first flask and Step are gifts; replacements can be crafted.
journal.myfirstmod.flask:
THE LAST FLAME

Charges: %s / %s

Hold use for 1.6s to heal four hearts. Damage interrupts.

Sneak-use near a safe waystone for 5s to restore health and charges. Keep a Mourning Ember offhand to add a charge, up to five.
journal.myfirstmod.cathedral:
MOURNING CATHEDRALS

Reliquaries opened: %s

Enter beneath the tall vault. Descend the west stair to the crypt, then the east stair to the ossuary.

Break or suppress the spawners. The lowest chamber holds the sealed reward.
journal.myfirstmod.funeral:
THE FUNERARY RITE

First: the drowned, in the middle crypt.
Second: the crowned, in the upper nave.
Last: the nameless, in the lowest ossuary.

Use their seals in order. Mistakes reset the rite. Return to the lowest reliquary when all three glow.
journal.myfirstmod.combat:
STEEL AND SILENCE

Knights commit to a cleave. Circle behind or land a heavy hit during the tell to stagger them.

Hunters mark a lunge; leave the mark.

Use Pilgrim’s Step to evade; sneak to backstep. The Warden takes 20% more melee damage in recovery.
item.myfirstmod.memory_shard.tooltip: Read forgotten memorials or complete ledger contracts. Trade for supplies or craft a permanent vow seal.
item.myfirstmod.pilgrim_atlas.tooltip: Use in the realm: survey loaded chunk centers and route to the nearest known landmark. Sneak-use cycles five categories. Never generates chunks.
item.myfirstmod.iron_vow.tooltip: Use near a safe waystone: permanent realm Resistance I and Slowness I. Consumed on change; 60s shared vow cooldown.
item.myfirstmod.ember_vow.tooltip: Use near a safe waystone: permanent realm Strength I and Hunger I. Consumed on change; 60s shared vow cooldown.
item.myfirstmod.mist_vow.tooltip: Use near a safe waystone: permanent realm Speed I and Weakness I. Consumed on change; 60s shared vow cooldown.
item.myfirstmod.silent_vow.tooltip: Use near a safe waystone to renounce your vow. Consumed on change; 60s shared vow cooldown.
message.myfirstmod.vow_unsafe: Vows can only change at a safe realm waystone: no nearby hostiles or enrolled encounters.
message.myfirstmod.vow_wait: That vow is already sworn, or your last change was less than 60 seconds ago.
message.myfirstmod.vow_chosen: VOW SWORN // %s. Its gifts and burdens follow you through the realm.
message.myfirstmod.atlas_target: ATLAS // %s at %s, %s, %s. The HUD shows your bearing.
message.myfirstmod.atlas_empty: No known %s. Survey loaded terrain with ordinary use, or visit and interact with a landmark.
message.myfirstmod.memory_known: You have already remembered this place, or your 256-memory archive is full.
message.myfirstmod.memory_found: REMEMBRANCE // Memory %s recorded. A shard and 25 experience recovered.
message.myfirstmod.ledger_cost: This offer costs %s Memory Shards held in your main hand.
message.myfirstmod.ledger_bought: Supplies received. Your memory is not forgotten.
message.myfirstmod.ledger_offer: LEDGER // %s for %s Memory Shards. Sneak-use changes offer; hold shards main-hand to buy. Otherwise use to claim contracts.
hud.myfirstmod.atlas_unknown: Use to survey; sneak to cycle
journal.myfirstmod.remembrance:
REMEMBRANCE

Memorials: %s
Contracts claimed: %s / 7
Vow: %s

Find bell towers, shelters, and grave gardens in new terrain. Use their stele once per player to recover a Memory Shard and a story.
journal.myfirstmod.vows:
VOWS

Craft two Memory Shards with an ingot (Iron), cinder pearl (Embers), or dusk fiber (Mist). Use near a safe waystone.

One vow, with a benefit and a burden. Silence clears it. Changes take 60s to recover. Effects linger up to 3s on leaving.
journal.myfirstmod.atlas:
PILGRIM ATLAS

Craft a compass, book, and prism dust. Use to survey the centers of loaded chunks nearby. Sneak-use cycles waystone, court, rift, cathedral, and unread memorial.

Remembers 128 sites. Old, unloaded markers may be stale.
journal.myfirstmod.ledger:
PILGRIM LEDGER

At the sanctuary or a crafted ledger, use without shards to claim eligible milestone contracts. Each pays once per player.

Sneak-use cycles supply offers. Hold Memory Shards main-hand and use to buy. Realm only.
memory.myfirstmod.0: The bell was not built to call the faithful. It warned the living when the city forgot a name.
memory.myfirstmod.1: The pilgrim left a full flask beneath this roof. No one remembers whether they ever returned.
memory.myfirstmod.2: Iron endured the siege. Embers fed the survivors. Mist carried their children beyond the walls.
memory.myfirstmod.3: The archivists sealed the crowned above the drowned, but left a place below for those without names.
memory.myfirstmod.4: They called the guardian cruel until the first star fell through the broken observatory.
memory.myfirstmod.5: Not every light in the fen is a soul. Some are promises that no one has yet broken.
journal.myfirstmod.gate:
ANCIENT THRESHOLD

Find the great reinforced frame in an Overworld Ancient City.

Keep its 22x8 outline intact and 20x6 opening clear. Use one Echo Shard on any frame block. Both orientations work.

The sanctuary gate returns you home.
item.myfirstmod.regent_crest.tooltip: Trophy of the Hollow Keep. Craft diagonally with a Resonite Ingot and stick for a Requiem Glaive.
item.myfirstmod.requiem_glaive.tooltip: Hold use for at least 1s, then release: six-block reaping arc, 14 damage, Slowness II. A successful hit grants 2 temporary hearts. 7s cooldown. Supports forge attunement.
message.myfirstmod.keep_locked: The Hollow Gate opens after the Null Warden has fallen in this realm.
message.myfirstmod.keep_building: The fortress is assembling. Wait a moment, then use the gate again.
message.myfirstmod.keep_busy: A Hollow Keep expedition is already active. Enrolled pilgrims may rejoin through the gate.
message.myfirstmod.keep_arrival: THE HOLLOW KEEP // Rest at the entrance. Gather allies near the Expedition Heart and use it to begin. The gate behind you always returns to the sanctuary.
message.myfirstmod.keep_begin: EXPEDITION BEGUN // Break the west, east, and north wards, one chamber at a time. Then return to the great hall. Rest is blocked until the expedition ends.
message.myfirstmod.keep_start_first: Use the Expedition Heart near the entrance with your allies to enroll first.
message.myfirstmod.keep_finish_room: Finish the active ward chamber before opening another.
message.myfirstmod.keep_ward_done: This ward has already fallen during this expedition.
message.myfirstmod.keep_room: WARD %s // Defeat its guardians. Their room is their tether.
message.myfirstmod.keep_ward_fallen: A ward falls silent. Find the next chamber, or return to the great hall.
message.myfirstmod.keep_emergence: The throne awakens… return to the great hall!
message.myfirstmod.keep_regent: THE GRAVE REGENT // The throne remembers your trespass.
message.myfirstmod.keep_victory: THE THRONE FALLS // Return through the Hollow Gate to claim your expedition rewards. The first clear awards a Requiem Glaive.
message.myfirstmod.keep_failed: The expedition ends without a completion reward. Regroup at the entrance before trying again.
message.myfirstmod.keep_mail: HOLLOW KEEP // %s clear rewards claimed: Regent Crests, Astral Cores, shards, and experience.
regent.myfirstmod.attack.1: ROYAL CLEAVE · Circle behind or retreat beyond five blocks
regent.myfirstmod.attack.2: FUNERAL RING · Inside 2.5 blocks or outside 7.5
regent.myfirstmod.attack.3: CROSS OF ASH · Leave both marked lanes
journal.myfirstmod.keep:
THE HOLLOW KEEP

Clears claimed: %s

After the Warden falls, use the gate at -6, 81, 158. Gather within 16 blocks of the Expedition Heart to enroll. Break west, east, and north wards, then face the Regent in the great hall.
journal.myfirstmod.regent:
THE GRAVE REGENT

Dodge the cleave, funeral ring, and marked cross. Below half health it attacks faster and harder.

Flasks, armor bonuses, and vows work in the Keep. Rest is blocked during a run. Return through the gate to claim rewards; your first clear grants a glaive.
message.myfirstmod.keep_landing: The arrival area is obstructed. Clear a safe landing near the gate or sanctuary.
message.myfirstmod.city_gate_location: The gateway must stand within an Ancient City in the Overworld.
message.myfirstmod.city_gate_incomplete: The great frame is incomplete or obstructed. Preserve its 22 by 8 outline and clear the 20 by 6 opening.
message.myfirstmod.city_gate_open: The ancient gateway is already awake.
message.myfirstmod.city_gate_awakened: The Ancient City answers. Cross the veil to enter the Null Realm.
item.myfirstmod.rootbound_seal.tooltip: One shared reward per monastery. Craft the Briarbrand with Resonite, Dusk Fiber and Hushwood.
item.myfirstmod.briarbrand.tooltip: Hold one second, then release a narrow four-block thorn sweep: 9 damage, Slowness III for three seconds, and one heart healed when it connects. Ten-second cooldown, three durability, attunable at the forge.
monastery.myfirstmod.riddle: Two bells stir the roots: one in the west chapel, one above the east library. Ring both, then return to this heart.
monastery.myfirstmod.bell: The cloister answers. Return to the Rootbound Heart after both bells have rung.
monastery.myfirstmod.active: The Prior is already awake. A missing guardian resets after six seconds nearby.
monastery.myfirstmod.blocked: Clear the space above the heart before waking the Prior.
monastery.myfirstmod.peaceful: The Prior cannot awaken in Peaceful difficulty.
monastery.myfirstmod.begin: The Rootbound Prior awakens. Leave the marked ground; strike during recovery.
monastery.myfirstmod.reward: You claim the monastery’s shared Rootbound Seal. Its roots can be reforged into the Briarbrand.
prior.myfirstmod.attack.1: Root Lash — leave the marked lane
prior.myfirstmod.attack.2: Thorn Crown — gaps or close center; watch the second pulse
journal.myfirstmod.monastery:
ROOTBOUND MONASTERY

Seek the great cloister in new Hushed Grove chunks. Bind its entrance waystone. Ring the west chapel bell and the upper east-library bell.

Wake the Prior in the north hall. Defeat it, then claim the shared seal from its heart.
message.myfirstmod.gate_charging: The frame remembers. Hold the Echo Shard nearby while the threshold awakens.
message.myfirstmod.gate_cancelled: The awakening fades. No Echo Shard was consumed.
journal.myfirstmod.regions:
EIGHT REGIONS

Grove, Highlands, Fen, Stacks, Wastes, Spires, Steps, Vents.

Highlands float; Stacks drown; Spires cut; Vents smoulder. Each keeps its own stone, fog and silence.

New regions generate only in new chunks.
journal.myfirstmod.seals:
ROYAL SEALS

Rootbound Seal: the monastery keeper.
Drowned Seal: the flooded archive.

Two more seals wait in the kingdom. The ledger remembers each region you have walked.
item.myfirstmod.drowned_seal.tooltip: Recovered from the drained archive vault. Craft the Tide Lantern with a Prism Lamp and a Resonite Ingot.
item.myfirstmod.tide_lantern.tooltip: Use: forty seconds of water breathing and twenty seconds of night vision. Ninety-second cooldown. The drowned archive's answer to deep water.
archive.myfirstmod.drained: The tide obeys. %s blocks of water drain from the hall.
archive.myfirstmod.dry: The bell rings over an already dry hall.
archive.myfirstmod.unloaded: The hall's waters lie beyond loaded chunks.
journal.myfirstmod.foundry:
ASHEN FOUNDRY

A sealed forge hall in the Cinder Steps.

The Ember Crucible sleeps behind a shell of standing fire. Only a pilgrim attuned to two seals may quench it.

The quench holds: fire falls, channels cool to slagglass, the vault opens.
journal.myfirstmod.chain:
THE CHAIN OF SEALS

Rootbound, Drowned, Cinder.

Attune a seal by holding it and using it in hand. The ledger remembers forever, and the sanctuary plinth counts the chain for all to see.

One seal still sleeps beneath the kingdom.
item.myfirstmod.cinder_seal.tooltip: Recovered from the quenched foundry vault. Craft the Cinderwalk Charm with Slagglass and a Resonite Ingot.
item.myfirstmod.cinderwalk_charm.tooltip: Carried: magma floors no longer burn you and flames die on your skin. The foundry's answer to the vents.
foundry.myfirstmod.quenched: The crucible sighs. The fire shell falls and the channels cool to slagglass.
foundry.myfirstmod.once: The quench holds. This forge is already cold.
foundry.myfirstmod.unworthy: The crucible answers only to a bearer of the Rootbound and Drowned seals.
foundry.myfirstmod.unloaded: The forge's fire lies beyond loaded chunks.
seal.myfirstmod.attuned: The %s binds to your ledger. The chain remembers.
seal.myfirstmod.known: This seal is already bound to your ledger.
seal.myfirstmod.plinth: The sanctuary plinth now bears %s seals.
item.myfirstmod.crown_seal.tooltip: The fourth seal, taken from the Silent Court. Craft the Crown of the Silent Court with a Resonite Block.
item.myfirstmod.silent_crown.tooltip: Worn: the realm no longer breaks your fall, and its dark becomes sight. The kingdom knows its crowned.
court.myfirstmod.unworthy: The Crown Gate answers only to a bearer of three seals.
court.myfirstmod.session: The court is in session. Stand your ground.
court.myfirstmod.ruled: The court has ruled. Its treasury is open.

journal.myfirstmod.capital:
SILENT CAPITAL

Due north of the sanctuary, past the last ridge: (0, -352).

Walls, boulevard, gardens, colonnades and a throne under a pale roof. The Crown Gate sleeps at the south door.
journal.myfirstmod.coronation:
CORONATION

Three seals attuned, use the Crown Gate. The court convenes in three sessions.

Outlive them and the throne treasury opens: the Crown Seal, last of the chain. Wear the crown and the realm softens.
journal.myfirstmod.landmarks:
LANDMARKS OF THE KINGDOM

Watchtowers crown the Highlands; brine chapels drown in the Stacks; geodes burst in Wastes and Spires; slag camps smoke in Steps and Vents.

Groves keep heartwood circles, fens keep light-shrines. Wrecks and rift scars lie everywhere.

Each holds a cache. Each remembers its region.
